newsitem.title: USA: AMR Corp Q4 net profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: AMR Corp Q4 net profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Primary and diluted share figures were the same for both quarters and the full year 1995. In full-year 1996, primary earnings were $11.63 per share on 87 million primary shares.

In 1996 Q4 the company recorded a $497 million gain on the initial public offering of SABRE Group. Partially offsetting that was a $230 million after-tax charge to write down its investment in and start-up costs for its relationship with Canadian Airlines.
The company also had an $89 million after-tax loss on repurchasing $624 million of unsecured debt and a $16 million after-tax charge to write down value of aircraft interiors it plans to refurbish.

The company said fourth quarter net earnings, excluding certain special items, were $122 million or $1.33 per common share, compared to 1995 net earnings before special charges of $90 million or $1.15 per share.
